import sys

from harness import run_consensus_phantom
sys.path.append('storage/shared/consensus_v1_8')
from aggregate_v1_8 import main as aggregate_main

# Pilot with extras and numeric fields
run_consensus_phantom(
    lineage="veritas",
    agent="Veritas III",
    seed=0,
    depth=5,
    agents=3,
    innovation={"myth_strength": 0.75, "heuristic": "index_vote", "equilibria_index": 0.5}
)

# Call aggregator
aggregate_main()
print("Aggregation Complete")
